user.description: Found {count} Govee light(s) on the LAN that are not set up yet. The built-in Govee lights local integration must be disabled first, because both need UDP port 4002.

manual.description: Enter the light's IP address. LAN Control must be on for it in the Govee app.

bulbs.description: How many bulbs does the {sku} at {ip} have? The light can't report this, because the same model ships in different lengths. Count them, or test with a pattern.

error.no_answer: No Govee light answered at that address. Check that LAN Control is on in the Govee app.

abort.port_in_use: UDP port 4002 is in use, probably by the built-in Govee lights local integration. Disable it, then try again.

paint.name: Paint bulbs
paint.description: Set the color, brightness or power of some bulbs. Bulbs with the same value share one command.

runs.name: Runs
runs.description: A list of runs: bulbs (e.g. "1-15,17" or [1, 2]) plus any of rgb, brightness (1-100) and on.

save_pattern.name: Save pattern
save_pattern.description: Save a per-bulb pattern, either from a string's current state or from an explicit list of bulbs.

name.name: Name
name.description: Pattern name. An existing pattern with this name is replaced.

bulbs.name: Bulbs
bulbs.description: Explicit bulbs, in order: rgb, plus optional brightness and on.

apply_pattern.name: Apply pattern
apply_pattern.description: Apply a saved pattern to a string.

fit.name: Fit
fit.description: What to do when the pattern's bulb count differs from the string's.
